cases.title: Eligible confirmed lock
cases.query: 我是全職員工，使用公司管理筆電，已註冊自助復原，現在明確顯示帳戶鎖定，應該怎麼處理？

baseline.reference_answer: 已確認帳戶鎖定，請透過 ExampleDesk 提交帳戶復原請求，附非機密錯訊、發生時間、裝置管理及復原註冊狀態。服務台會確認下一步；目前未替您解鎖。
must_include: Use ExampleDesk for confirmed lock.
Do not collect passwords or verification codes.
Do not promise that a request completes an unlock.
must_not: Provide self-service recovery as the first action.
Treat password expiry as an account lock.
Claim an unlock was executed.

Apply the notice only on or after 2030-03-01.
Retain the service-desk fallback for unsuccessful recovery.

Claim recovery has been executed.
Change the password-expiry procedure.

Treat a successful VPN connection as overseas approval.
